versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: צַ֞ו אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר לְהַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד׃

controles.web: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
controles.kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
controles.livre: Manda aos filhos de Israel que te tragam azeite de olivas claro, prensado, para a luminária, para fazer arder as lâmpadas continuamente.

versos.hebraico: מִחוּץ֩ לְפָרֹ֨כֶת הָעֵדֻ֜ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַהֲרֹ֜ן מֵעֶ֧רֶב עַד־בֹּ֛קֶר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh continually: it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
controles.kjv: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the Lord continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
controles.livre: Fora do véu do testemunho, no tabernáculo do testemunho, as preparará Arão desde a tarde até a manhã diante do SENHOR, continuamente: estatuto perpétuo por vossas gerações.

versos.hebraico: עַ֚ל הַמְּנֹרָ֣ה הַטְּהֹרָ֔ה יַעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֶת־הַנֵּר֑וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃פ

controles.web: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before Yahweh continually.
controles.kjv: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the Lord continually.
controles.livre: Sobre o candelabro limpo porá sempre em ordem as lâmpadas diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ סֹ֔לֶת וְאָפִיתָ֣ אֹתָ֔הּ שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה חַלּ֑וֹת שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים יִהְיֶ֖ה הַֽחַלָּ֥ה הָאֶחָֽת׃

controles.web: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenth parts of an ephah shall be in one cake.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
controles.livre: E tomarás flor de farinha, e cozerás dela doze tortas: cada torta será de duas dízimas.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֛ם שְׁתַּ֥יִם מַֽעֲרָכ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ הַֽמַּעֲרָ֑כֶת עַ֛ל הַשֻּׁלְחָ֥ן הַטָּהֹ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the Lord.
controles.livre: E hás de pô-las em duas ordens, seis em cada ordem, sobre a mesa limpa diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּ֥ עַל־הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֖כֶת לְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה וְהָיְתָ֤ה לַלֶּ֨חֶם֙ לְאַזְכָּרָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Porás também sobre cada ordem incenso limpo, e será para o pão por incenso, oferta acesa ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: בְּי֨וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֜ת בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֗ת יַֽעַרְכֶ֛נּוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד מֵאֵ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is on the behalf of the children of Israel an everlasting covenant.
controles.kjv: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the Lord continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
controles.livre: Cada dia de sábado o porá continuamente em ordem diante do SENHOR, dos filhos de Israel por pacto sempiterno.

versos.hebraico: וְהָֽיְתָה֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּלְבָנָ֔יו וַאֲכָלֻ֖הוּ בְּמָק֣וֹם קָדֹ֑שׁ כִּ֡י קֹדֶשׁ֩ קָֽדָשִׁ֨ים ה֥וּא ל֛וֹ מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָ֖ה חָק־עוֹלָֽם׃ס

controles.web: It shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy to him of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire by a perpetual statute.”
controles.kjv: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the Lord made by fire by a perpetual statute.
controles.livre: E será de Arão e de seus filhos, os quais o comerão no lugar santo; porque é coisa muito santa para ele, das ofertas acendidas ao SENHOR, por estatuto perpétuo.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּצֵא֙ בֶּן־אִשָּׁ֣ה יִשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית וְהוּא֙ בֶּן־אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּנָּצוּ֙ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה בֶּ֚ן הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית וְאִ֖ישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִֽי׃

controles.web: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
controles.kjv: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
controles.livre: Naquela muita o filho de uma mulher israelita, o qual era filho de um egípcio, saiu entre os filhos de Israel; e o filho da israelita e um homem de Israel brigaram no acampamento:

versos.hebraico: וַ֠יִּקֹּב בֶּן־הָֽאִשָּׁ֨ה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֤ית אֶת־הַשֵּׁם֙ וַיְקַלֵּ֔ל וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְשֵׁ֥ם אִמּ֛וֹ שְׁלֹמִ֥ית בַּת־דִּבְרִ֖י לְמַטֵּה־דָֽן׃

controles.web: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
controles.kjv: And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
controles.livre: E o filho da mulher israelita pronunciou o Nome, e amaldiçoou: então o levaram a Moisés. E sua mãe se chamava Selomite, filha de Dribi, da tribo de Dã.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּנִּיחֻ֖הוּ בַּמִּשְׁמָ֑ר לִפְרֹ֥שׁ לָהֶ֖ם עַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: They put him in custody, until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.
controles.kjv: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the Lord might be shewed them.
controles.livre: E puseram-no no cárcere, até que lhes fosse sentenciado pela palavra do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הוֹצֵ֣א אֶת־הַֽמְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל־מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְסָמְכ֧וּ כָֽל־הַשֹּׁמְעִ֛ים אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְרָגְמ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ כָּל־הָעֵדָֽה׃

controles.web: “Bring out of the camp him who cursed; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
controles.kjv: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
controles.livre: Tira ao blasfemo fora do acampamento, e todos os que o ouviram ponham suas mãos sobre a cabeça dele, e apedreje-o toda a congregação.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ כִּֽי־יְקַלֵּ֥ל אֱלֹהָ֖יו וְנָשָׂ֥א חֶטְאֽוֹ׃

controles.web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
controles.livre: E aos filhos de Israel falarás, dizendo: Qualquer um que amaldiçoar a seu Deus, levará sua iniquidade.

versos.hebraico: וְנֹקֵ֤ב שֵׁם־יְהוָה֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת רָג֥וֹם יִרְגְּמוּ־ב֖וֹ כָּל־הָעֵדָ֑ה כַּגֵּר֙ כָּֽאֶזְרָ֔ח בְּנָקְבוֹ־שֵׁ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃

controles.web: He who blasphemes Yahweh’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born, when he blasphemes the Name, shall be put to death.
controles.kjv: And he that blasphemeth the name of the Lord, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.
controles.livre: E o que blasfemar o nome do SENHOR, será morto; toda a congregação o apedrejará: tanto o estrangeiro como o natural, se blasfemar o Nome, que morra.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַכֶּ֖ה כָּל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃

controles.web: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
controles.kjv: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
controles.livre: Também o homem que fere de morte a qualquer pessoa, que sofra a morte.

versos.hebraico: וּמַכֵּ֥ה נֶֽפֶשׁ־בְּהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ תַּ֥חַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃

controles.web: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
controles.kjv: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
controles.livre: E o que fere a algum animal há de restituí-lo: animal por animal.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־יִתֵּ֥ן מ֖וּם בַּעֲמִית֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה כֵּ֖ן יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: If anyone injures his neighbor; as he has done, so shall it be done to him:
controles.kjv: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
controles.livre: E o que causar lesão em seu próximo, segundo fez, assim lhe seja feito:

versos.hebraico: שֶׁ֚בֶר תַּ֣חַת שֶׁ֔בֶר עַ֚יִן תַּ֣חַת עַ֔יִן שֵׁ֖ן תַּ֣חַת שֵׁ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מוּם֙ בָּֽאָדָ֔ם כֵּ֖ן יִנָּ֥תֶן בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he has injured someone, so shall it be done to him.
controles.kjv: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
controles.livre: Rompimento por rompimento, olho por olho, dente por dente: segundo a lesão que haverá feito a outro, tal se fará a ele.

versos.hebraico: וּמַכֵּ֥ה בְהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה וּמַכֵּ֥ה אָדָ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃

controles.web: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
controles.kjv: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
controles.livre: O que fere algum animal, há de restituí-lo; mas o que fere de morte a um homem, que morra.

versos.hebraico: מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֶחָד֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כַּגֵּ֥ר כָּאֶזְרָ֖ח יִהְיֶ֑ה כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am Yahweh your God.’”
controles.kjv: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Um mesmo regulamento tereis: como o estrangeiro, assim será o natural: porque eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת־הַֽמְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל־מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ אָ֑בֶן וּבְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עָשׂ֔וּ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

controles.web: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought out him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E falou Moisés aos filhos de Israel, e eles tiraram ao blasfemo fora do acampamento, e apedrejaram-no com pedras. E os filhos de Israel fizeram segundo que o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
